summary: Rule the USA like a mob boss. Bribe, blackmail, and escape your past crimes!
description: 🦅 Rule the United States like a true mob boss. This Is the President is a story-driven management game. Now that you've bought... wait, won the 2020 Election, your ultimate goal is to ratify Amendment 28 to grant yourself lifelong immunity. But the road there is full of pitfalls, and you'll need to clean up daily messes. Some might even call these distractions "presidential duties." 🗽 A POLITICAL THRILLER-SATIRE MIX Score easy points by price-capping video games, or go big and regulate the whole Internet. In this political thriller-satire mix, your actions inescapably escalate into absurd situations. Rescue a toppled Russian president, send a hamster into space, or help a serial killer escape prison! 🕴️ MANAGE YOUR SHADOW CABINET Thugs, hackers, journalists, and lawyers... you’ll need a variety of talents. When staff members dislike your decisions, remind them who covers up their dirty little secrets, like gambling, alcohol, and domestic violence. There is no moral dilemma that cannot be solved with a juicy bonus from our charity fund. 📜 CHANGE THE CONSTITUTION Americans can put their faith in their cute little "separation of powers" all they want, but no one can resist your methods. Persuade, blackmail, bribe, and bully the political system into granting you lifelong immunity. Nothing can separate power from you. KEY FEATURES: 📈 Rule By Any Means: Manage your approval rating, cash, and crew unlike any US President before. Stay on top by any means necessary. 🏛️ Command the Oval Office: Hold speeches, draft executive orders, manage daily crises, and tweet better than any President before. 🕵️ Deploy Specialists: Send a team of assassins, hackers, and lobbyists on dangerous missions that can be solved legally... or illegally. 🌎 Global Fear & Respect: Rule the country with a shadow cabinet that is feared and respected on a global scale. 📖 Interactive Narrative: Experience a compelling, branching storyline. Will you end your term on your terms, or are you just a pawn in a bigger game? Supported languages: EN/RU © 2026 THQ Nordic Mobile
